title: Bigboy's Chew Toy

sources.title: Whossa Large Fellow?
markers: | summary = It is granted by {{SmRarityItem|Bigboy's Chew Toy}}, and allows the wielder to enlarge themselves in a manner similar to {{SAI|Enlarge}}.

summary: A +1 quarterstaff that lets you enlarge yourself.

fields.Whossa Large Fellow?: Action once per Long Rest. Enlarge yourself for 10 turns, gaining advantage on Strength checks and saves and +1d4 weapon damage.
fields.Base value: 310 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
